item.title: OpenEvolve: Teaching LLMs to Discover Algorithms Through Evolution
item.description:
📝 Candidate programs are produced via LLM-guided edits (diff-based by default), evaluated with user-defined metrics, and organized using MAP-Elites while an island model with migration supports parallel, diversified exploration. Program Database: Implements MAP-Elites per island, binning programs along configurable feature dimensions (defaults include complexity and diversity; custom dimensions are taken from evaluator metrics). Cascade Evaluation Evaluation proceeds in stages with configurable thresholds.
🔗 Read more: https://algorithmicsuperintelligence.ai/blog/openevolve-overview/index.html
